answer: A sable ledger follows the money, not the names: cluster identities by their funding graph — wallets sharing one source, a first deposit, or an exit address count as a single account for reward weight. A sybil splitting capital across a hundred jade accounts gains nothing, because the ledger sees siblings of one family tree and divides the share among them. Honest strangers who never pooled stay distinct as separate nebulas, each at full weight. Fresh names buy nothing; genuine independence costs what honest participation costs, per identity, forever.
